purpose: Test whether short and longer inputs require separate decision cutoffs after review-05 training
runtime_grouping: Language and focal-message whitespace word count <=12 or >12; no labels, source metadata or dataset family at inference
threshold_fit: For each language/length group, use the development positive-score 1st percentile order statistic, with the same 1e-4 numerical margin. Fall back to the language cutoff if fewer than 100 positive development examples.
evaluation: Report original language-only and length-conditioned decisions on development and calibration, including formal/conversational groups. No training, no evaluation-set threshold tuning.
